sections.title: US strikes Iranian air defences
sections.body: The US hit surface-to-air missile sites on Qeshm and Hengam islands on 2 November, AP reports, citing an official who called it defensive. No on-record US statement was found.

sections.title: Iran claims four tankers mined
sections.body: Iran's Guard says four tankers hit mines on a prohibited route on 4 November; no ship was named and there is no independent confirmation. An Indian crewman died when a dhow was hit off Oman on 3 November.

sections.title: Democrats win Congress
sections.body: Democrats took both chambers, with at least 54 Senate seats. Trump said the Iran war and fuel prices played a part but defended the decision.

sections.title: Russia's largest grid strike this year
sections.body: Russia fired 76 missiles and 289 drones at Ukraine's energy system on 3 November, hitting a substation that serves the Khmelnytskyi nuclear plant. Kyiv lost power and water.

sections.title: Abu Dhabi talks set for 10-11 November
sections.body: The US will mediate Ukraine-Russia working-level talks; the Kremlin confirmed. Lavrov rejected an immediate ceasefire and narrower truces the same day.

sections.title: Houthis advance toward Aden
sections.body: Reuters, citing military sources, says Houthi forces took Al-Maqatirah and are within about 80 km of Aden, with the Taiz-Aden road cut since early October.

key_developments: US strikes hit Iranian surface-to-air sites on Qeshm and Hengam on 2 November, AP reports, citing a US official.
Iran cuts its Hormuz reopening timetable from seven days to two, with the same conditions.
India: 15 Indian seafarers killed near Hormuz since March after the Al-Jusufi death.
Russia's 3 November strike hit a substation serving the Khmelnytskyi nuclear plant.
Komyshuvakha aid-point strike kills at least 31, with about 50 missing.
Taiwan records 49 Chinese military sorties in a day, its highest this year.
since_last_visit_brief: The US struck Iranian air defences on Qeshm, Democrats won Congress, and Russia hit Ukraine's grid hardest this year as Abu Dhabi talks were set.
